scenarios_snapshot_shape.name: scenarios_snapshot_shape
scenarios_snapshot_shape.value: ("scenarios"."simulation_input" is null and "scenarios"."baseline_snapshot" is null and "scenarios"."baseline_hash" is null and "scenarios"."engine_version" is null and "scenarios"."simulation_output" is null) or (jsonb_typeof("scenarios"."simulation_input") = 'object' and jsonb_typeof("scenarios"."baseline_snapshot") = 'object' and "scenarios"."baseline_hash" is not null and "scenarios"."engine_version" is not null) is true

shipments_supply_valid.name: shipments_supply_valid
shipments_supply_valid.value: ("shipments"."quantity" is null or "shipments"."quantity" > 0) and ("shipments"."confirmed_quantity" is null or ("shipments"."quantity" is not null and "shipments"."confirmed_quantity" between 0 and "shipments"."quantity" and "shipments"."verified_until" is not null)) and ("shipments"."inventory_id" is null or ("shipments"."quantity" is not null and length(trim("shipments"."unit")) > 0) is true)

disruptions_dates_ordered.name: disruptions_dates_ordered
disruptions_dates_ordered.value: "disruptions"."ends_at" is null or "disruptions"."starts_at" is null or "disruptions"."ends_at" >= "disruptions"."starts_at"

locations_coordinates_valid.name: locations_coordinates_valid
locations_coordinates_valid.value: ("locations"."longitude" is null and "locations"."latitude" is null) or ("locations"."longitude" is not null and "locations"."latitude" is not null and "locations"."longitude" between -180 and 180 and "locations"."latitude" between -90 and 90)

supplier_products_classification_valid.name: supplier_products_classification_valid
supplier_products_classification_valid.value: ("supplier_products"."product_id" is not null or "supplier_products"."hs_code" is not null) and ("supplier_products"."hs_code" is null or ("supplier_products"."hs_code" ~ '^[0-9]{2,8}$' and "supplier_products"."classification" is not null))

suppliers_verification_valid.name: suppliers_verification_valid
suppliers_verification_valid.value: "suppliers"."verification_status" in ('unverified','verified','rejected') and ("suppliers"."verification_status" <> 'verified' or ("suppliers"."verified_at" is not null and "suppliers"."expires_at" > "suppliers"."verified_at") is true)

connections_metadata_valid.name: connections_metadata_valid
connections_metadata_valid.value: "transport_connections"."routing_metadata" is null or ((jsonb_typeof("transport_connections"."routing_metadata") = 'object' and "transport_connections"."routing_metadata"->>'version' = '1' and jsonb_typeof("transport_connections"."routing_metadata"->'hypothetical') = 'boolean' and "transport_connections"."routing_metadata"->>'state' in ('open','closed','unknown')) is true)
